messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi there. I need some assistance with updating my shipping address.

Hi there! I can definitely help with that. To update your shipping address, I'll need to know your user ID. Could you please provide it? If you don't have it, you can also give me your email or your name and zip code, and I can find your user ID for you.
Oh, I don't have my user ID or email on me. But I can give you my name and zip code. It's Ethan Garcia, and the zip code is 80280.

Great, thanks for providing your name and zip code. I found your user ID, which is ethan_garcia_1261. Now, I can proceed to update your shipping address. Could you please provide the new address details?
Sure, the new address is 101 Highway, New York, 10001. I want to make sure this change is applied to all my order addresses as well.
The new shipping address has been successfully updated for your account. It will now be applied to all your order addresses. If you need any further assistance, feel free to let me know!
Thank you! I appreciate that. But actually, I've changed my mind. I want to revert the address back to my original one. Can you help with that?
Certainly, I can help with that. To revert the address back to your original one, I'll need to know your original address. Could you please provide the details of your original address?
My original address is Ethan Garcia, Denver, 80280. I want the address for my account and all my order addresses changed back to this one.

The address for your account and all your order addresses has been successfully changed back to Ethan Garcia, Denver, 80280. If you have any more questions or need further assistance, please let me know.

Thank you so much for your help. I really appreciate it. I think I'm all set now.

###STOP###
